Breakout-Fighting Set - High Strength: Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel Cleanser 400ml, Effaclar Ultra Concentrated Serum 30ml, Effaclar Duo+M Anti-Blemish Corrective Gel Moisturiser 40ml
The Effaclar trio is a zinc foaming cleanser, an acid serum and a niacinamide gel-cream. CeraVe's oily-skin foaming cleanser plus The Ordinary's 2% salicylic acid and 10% niacinamide + zinc serums cover the same three jobs for about 60% less.

Where the kit differs
La Roche-Posay does not publish percentages, so strengths cannot be matched. The Effaclar Ultra Concentrated Serum combines salicylic, glycolic and lipo-hydroxy acid with niacinamide; The Ordinary's serum is salicylic acid alone (2%), with no glycolic acid or LHA. Duo+M is a gel-cream moisturiser with salicylic acid, LHA, piroctone olamine and its Procerad/Phylobioma complex; The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a watery serum with no exfoliating acid, so you may still want a plain moisturiser on top. The Effaclar cleanser is a zinc PCA foaming gel; CeraVe's foaming cleanser has niacinamide and ceramides but no zinc. Three separate bottles instead of one boxed set, and the CeraVe cleanser is a bigger 473ml bottle (priced pro rata). LOOKFANTASTIC's £14.80 CeraVe price is 20% off its £18.50 RRP (site-wide SAVE20 offer); at RRP the rebuild is still about 55% cheaper.
The kit also comes with: Sold at LOOKFANTASTIC (RRP £84.90, shown at £63.68, 25% off, in Nov 2026)
How we checked each item
Set contents, sizes, price and key ingredients (zinc PCA in the cleanser; salicylic acid, glycolic acid, capryloyl salicylic acid and niacinamide in the serum; niacinamide, salicylic acid, LHA, zinc PCA in Duo+M) from the LOOKFANTASTIC set page. CeraVe Foaming Cleanser 473ml INCI (niacinamide, ceramides NP/AP/EOP, sodium hyaluronate) and £14.80 price from LOOKFANTASTIC. The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution 30ml £6.10 and Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% 30ml £5.00, with full INCI, from theordinary.com/en-gb.
